senses.gloss: (Arab. ḥama tueri) [to surround, guard, v. חוֹמָה,] to observe, see (in Y. dialect).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:4">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 4</cite> (O. <he>חזא</he>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:33">Targ. Prov. XXIII, 33</cite> Ms. (ed. <he>ויחַוְור׳</he>).—Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ bot. <he>אתא חמי</he> (= <he>תא חזי</he>, h. <he>בא וראה</he>) come and see.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> <he>דאת חָמֵי לאפויי וכ׳</he> (not <he>דאתח׳</he>) that thou shalt see his face in the hereafter; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 2:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. II; Yalk. ib. 621</cite> <he>חמוי</he> (corr. acc.).

Ib. חַמְתֵיה (fr. חמה) he saw him. Pesik. Eth Korb. p. 57ᵇ (v. Bub. note 15) חַמְתִי אכיל חַמְתִי שתי did he (Moses) see me (the Lord) eat &c.?; Yalk. Num. 776 חַמְתֵיה וכ׳ did he see Him &c.?; a. fr.—Part. pass. חֲמֵי (v. חֲזִי) fit, worthy.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 15:1">Targ. Ps. XV, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 58:2">Ib. LVIII, 2</cite> (ed. <cite ref="H01172"><he>חֲמִי</he></cite>); a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="H01032"><he>חַמְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 22:16">Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 28:27">Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 27</cite> (Ar. <he>מהמי</he>, h. text <he>מעלים</he>, v. Syr. <he>המא</he> P. Sm. 1017).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 41:28">Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 28</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ואַחְמִין ליה וכ׳</he> and showed him a measure full of denars.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד כות׳</he> 1) <he>דכל עמא מַחְמִין לי וכ׳</he> that all people point at me with their fingers.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H01171">same</cite>. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. <cite ref="H01172"><he>חַמֵּי</he></cite> (<cite ref="O01410"><he>לה</he></cite>) <cite ref="L00400"><he>לי</he></cite> let me see it (the tooth).

units: Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 5; a. fr.—[Targ. Ps. XLII, 3 אִתַּחֲמֵי Ms. (Ittaf.) I shall appear before (h. text אֵרָאֶה, Var. a. ed. אֶחְמֵי)].—

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:13">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אִתְחֲמִיאוּ וכ׳</he> stars were seen in day time. Y. Peah VIII, end, 21ᵇ <he>דחמי ולא מִתְחֲמֵי</he> He who sees but cannot be seen. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>מִתְחַמְאִין</he>, v. <cite ref="M02996"><he>מַשְׁתָּיֵי</he></cite>; a. e.
